clues: This city is in the state of Paraná in Brazil. Its small airport has flights to Curitiba.
Summers here are warm and winters are mild, but frost is common on winter mornings. Snow can even fall at times, and July is the coldest month.
It first was a village in nineteen forty-two. Ten years on, it was made a city.
A Brazil star striker comes from this city. He played for Chelsea and AC Milan in Europe.
A keeper born in this city holds a goals record. He scored 131 goals, the most by a keeper ever.
